newsitem.title: INDIA: India wants full rupee convertibility soon-PM.
newsitem.headline: India wants full rupee convertibility soon-PM.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister H. D.Deve Gowda said on Thursday that his country wants to move towards full rupee convertibility on the capital account as soon as possible.
Deve Gowda told a business conference in New Delhi that the rupee was already fully convertible on the current account and in many respects also convertible on the capital acccount.
"It is our intention to move towards full convertibility as early as possible. Today, the Indian economy is on a high growth path," the Prime Minister said.
